BEFORE WE GET STARTED

A few helpful answers.

Where do you work?

FenceCraft lists coverage across Flintshire, Cheshire, Wrexham and the Wirral. Share your postcode so availability and the practicalities of your project can be confirmed.

Is the quotation free?

FenceCraft offers free, no-obligation quotations. A site visit may be needed to understand the work and provide an accurate price.

How quickly will I hear back?

For an initial conversation, call 07935 190681 or email info@fence-craft.co.uk.

Do you work with caravan parks?

Yes. FenceCraft carries out park maintenance, static-caravan painting, footing works, fencing and decking. Tell us the location and the work you need to discuss availability and scope.
